score.prompt: Modern cinematic racing-film score, 84 seconds, instrumental only, no vocals. 0-9s: low wind-like synth drone and a rising engine-like riser. 9-25s: pulsing low synth bass and taiko drums at 120 bpm, building tension. 25-33s: drops to a ticking hi-hat and a single dark piano note. 33-44s: low strings swell, drums return, faster. 44-50s: full hit then sudden stop for 3 seconds of near silence. 53-60s: score slams back, driving, heroic. 60-69s: everything muffles to a slow heartbeat and a high sustained tone. 69-78s: huge build. 78-84s: fades to a lone high tone.
